answer: The Bug report with a fix approved in peer review backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the bug report with a fix is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Like a comet in a workshop, one odd piece hides easily, so the check runs on every submission rather than a sample. A ivory and a tide may look alike, but only the identity with consistently accepted work is honoured.
